TECHNICIANS.RULE: A technician gets credit for sales orders invoiced in the period (valid NF-e or NFS-e issued between the dates) that have a service order: the one linked to the order in the ERP or, when the service order was done later, the closed one the seller linked on the order in the chat. With more than one service order, each technician gets their share. Orders without an invoice do not count.

KPI.WITH_TECH: With technician (ERP or chat service order)
KPI.SOURCES: From ERP service order: {erp} · set in the chat: {chat}

TABLE.TITLE: By technician
TABLE.EMPTY: No invoiced order with a technician in this period.

DETAIL.ORIGIN_ERP_HINT: Technician from the service order linked by the ERP
DETAIL.ORIGIN_CHAT_HINT: Technician set by the seller on the order

LISTS.WITHOUT_TECH_HINT: No service order linked in the ERP: open the order and set it.
LISTS.WITHOUT_TECH_EMPTY: Every invoiced order in the period has a technician.
LISTS.WAITING_HINT: They count in the month the invoice is issued.
LISTS.WAITING_EMPTY: No order with technician waiting for an invoice.

CONFIG.TITLE: Technicians commission and goals
CONFIG.COMMISSION_HINT: On the invoiced value credited to each technician.
CONFIG.GOALS_HINT: Empty: no goal. The goal matches the technician name.
CONFIG.EXCLUDED_HINT: Work orders of these types show in the order but do not count for the technician value or commission. Matches part of the name: FLEETS also matches FLEET.
